verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents Dives, which generate interactive, shareable dashboards from natural-language prompts that can be refined conversationally and kept current with the data. The remote MCP server lets an agent analyze data in natural language (e.g., "give me some analytics"). However, much of this AI analysis runs through an external AI assistant connected over MCP rather than an assistant clearly built into the MotherDuck UI, and nothing shows the product proactively surfacing insights or suggestions. missing for 10: proactive AI-generated insights/suggestions, clear evidence the AI experience runs natively inside the MotherDuck UI rather than via an external MCP-connected agent, independent hands-on corroboration.
